decisions: C799: original809 failed because CSharp flow/direct RuntimeMouseEvents cases invoked an obsolete main-only guard. Remove those two checks while preserving Source input, arity, move ownership and target capabilities. Original809 now compiles and links on Windows and Linux; direct-call function control and unchanged literal-capacity negatives pass.

SLG effects.disallowedMainOnlyCall independently rejects exactly sys.input.mouse.Source.events inside a lexical function. Remove only this obsolete declaration predicate. Function LLVM call lowering already recognizes module/sys.input.mouse + Source + events and emits the affine producer without a main-only fallback.

Six CSharp constants own worker helpers, lifecycle helpers, Windows/Linux platform functions and platform declarations. All original SLG instruction lines match those constants after whitespace and existing #0 markers; lifecycle contains two raw literal blocks, both included. Preserve queue bounds, cancellation, worker shutdown, join-before-destroy and partial startup cleanup.

Split the common body at its existing lifecycle boundary, keeping each constant within16384 characters. Reuse the existing generated NativeRuntime region and preserve function emission order. No target, ownership or input relaxation.
